editor_reconstruction_note: Quote card grows from tiny and blurred to full size top-centre, reading 'Q. What if everything was antimatter, EXCEPT Earth?' and '— Sean Gallagher' in grey rounded box.
Empty board rectangle fills at once with dark grey starfield: small spiral galaxy upper-left, comet with white tail lower-right, scattered white specks.
White label 'ANTIMATTER' appears at board top-centre with about seven curved white arrows radiating outward to galaxy, comet and edges.
Black label 'MATTER' and black-and-white Earth globe with dashed ring appear lower-centre of board; small arrow from label to globe.
Figure redrawn: one arm raised toward the face/chin (thinking pose) while the other still holds the paper; no head tilt visible at 0.6 scale; board unchanged.
Figure redrawn with one arm raised outward and head upright; board unchanged.
Red ellipse appears around the white 'ANTIMATTER' label on the board; single sampled frame so draw-on vs pop-on UNRESOLVED.
Red letter 'R' appears on the Earth globe.
Second red letter added: 'RI' on Earth.
Third red letter added: red 'RIP' on Earth.

Hard cut at 11.79s to full-frame red title card: black T-rex on a satellite upper-centre, white text 'xkcd's what if? THE VIDEO SERIES'. Card lasts about 2s with slight internal drift of the artwork in sampled tiles; at f331 (13.79s) hard cut to grey scene with figure labelled 'MATTER' and large speckled circle.
Title 'MATTER' typed in black at top-centre: 'M', 'MATT', 'MATTER' across frames.
Balance scale appears: tall post with tilted beam resting on the speckled circle, tiny pan at right end, white label 'ANTIMATTER' top-right, caption 'BARYON ASYMMETRY PROBLEM' along bottom.
Beam appears level rather than tilted; nothing else visibly different. Exact change UNRESOLVED.
Matter circle shrinks to small size hanging from beam left end; white speckled antimatter circle appears at right end.
Figure redrawn with arms out in a shrug.
Both circles removed from the scale leaving empty beam; figure shrug slightly redrawn.
Hard cut to darker grey night sky with dark specks, galaxies, label 'MATTER GALAXIES' centre, black tree silhouette lower-left and tiny stick figure with telescope.
White label 'ANTIMATTER GALAXY' with arrow appears upper-centre; the large galaxy turns white.
No visible change at tile scale; small residual pixel change UNRESOLVED.
White dashed ellipse drawn around the white galaxy; then text written along its lower edge: black 'MA', then 'ANT' (white) and 'MATTER' (black), ending as 'ANTIMATTER' above 'MATTER' at a slant.
Red glowing halo with short spikes appears around the dashed ellipse (gamma-ray glow).
Red glow, dashed ellipse, boundary text and 'ANTIMATTER GALAXY' label all removed; galaxy back to dark ink.
Ribbed cylindrical telescope-like object appears upper-left of galaxy; small red dot appears near galaxy.
Sky dissolves through near-empty grey to inverted state: all specks and galaxy white, label changes to 'ANTIMATTER UNIVERSE'; red dot fades out; telescope object persists.
Small label 'UH-OH.' with tick appears above the stick figure at lower-left.
Hard cut to grey canvas: label 'OUTER SPACE' top-centre, black Earth silhouette centre, large stick figure lower-right with arms stretched out horizontally.
Red scribble strike drawn over 'SPACE' across the 4 frames.
Label 'GAS' with arrow appears upper-right; blurry dark concentric bands fade in over background; figure redrawn with both arms raised in a shrug.
Label 'PLASMA' with curved arrow to Earth and short arrow down appears left.
Figure redrawn with head tilted and hand to face.
Label 'DUST' with curved arrows appears lower-left, with scattered small dust specks across canvas.
Figure redrawn with arm lowered.
Black ball with trail and label 'METEOROID' with arrow appear right of Earth; background bands change; figure arm changes.
Labels switch to white 'ANTI-GAS', 'ANTI-PLASMA', 'ANTI-DUST', 'ANTI-METEOROID'; meteoroid ball becomes white; arrows white; bands brighten. Single-frame swap.
Hard cut to grey diagram: many black magnetic field lines around small Earth centre-right, label 'SOLAR WIND' upper-left, black arrow splitting around Earth.
Left-side lines and arrow turn white; label becomes 'ANTI-SOLAR WIND'.
Two extra white curved arrows appear above and below, bending toward Earth.
Hard cut to painted dark sky with blurred green and red aurora streaks; two dark silhouette figures sitting on a hill lower-right.
Aurora brightens to saturated red, yellow and green over 6 frames; figures' arms rise.
Black meteor streaks with white impact arcs appear across sky upper-left and right; figures now standing close together.
Hard cut to speckled grey field with Earth (dashed ring, black ink) lower-left and trail lines to bottom-left.
Earth and trail relocate to upper-right; speckled field unchanged.
Black text typed above-right of Earth: '~', '~30 T', '~30 TONS/', '~30 TONS/DAY'.
Small text typed under it: '1', '10-5 GR', '10-5 GRAMS' (10 with superscript -5).
Black dots with streaks pop on: upper-left first, then cluster at Earth's right edge, then lower-right; second '~30 TONS/DAY' text appears right of Earth.

Radial motion-blur zoom rushing into Earth and text, then heavy blur of Earth surface and dust; by f2256 resolves to new scene: 'MATTER ATMOSPHERE' black dots left, 'ANTIMATTER DUST' white streaked dots upper-right.
Red radial burst with wavy spikes appears at centre where dots meet.
Hard cut to plain grey; black circles marked with plus signs and clusters pop on progressively from upper-left filling left half over 7 frames.
White circles marked with minus signs and clusters pop on across the right half over 7 frames.
Tangle of black and white looping curves appears at centre (particle interactions).
Black and white arrows radiate from tangle, ending in small Greek-like symbols (unreadable at tile scale).
Red wavy lines radiate from centre.
Red gradient wash with long red wavy lines fills left and lower-left.
Hard cut to Earth with ring and trail on light-to-dark grey gradient with white specks.
Earth and trail shift slightly up and right; nothing new visible.
Black arrow appears from the wedge pointing up-right; Earth surface shows a lighter wedge shading.
Red glow appears on right limb of Earth.
Red glow expands around Earth.
Red glow intensifies around the whole Earth.
Diagonal red and grey stripes appear on Earth's surface; glow strong.
Glow and stripes fade; Earth dark again; white meteoroid with streak appears upper-left of Earth at f2886.

Hard cut to museum: label 'MATTER MUSEUM', T-rex skeleton on plinth 'SUE', plaque, two small stick figures, black round rock on plinth 'CHELYABINSK METEOR' and white round rock on plinth 'ANTIMATTER METEOR'.
Horizontal measuring bracket drawn across black meteor with '~19m', then across white meteor in grey.
Scene shrinks with blur; huge black shape fills upper-right; '≈ ~15km' with arrow appears; small blurred squiggle between meteor and giant shape at f3030 UNRESOLVED.
Hard cut to grey sky with glowing black meteor with tail upper-left, silhouette trees, lamp posts, house, one stick figure.
Two thin streak meteors appear to the right of the large one.
Red glowing trails and white splash/shockwave shapes appear in sky; rooftops outlined white.
Yellow-orange flames along ground and trees with black smoke squiggles; stick figure now running.
Hard cut to grey night sky: galaxy and dark meteor upper-left, second meteor right, tree silhouettes left and right, stick figure with telescope lower-centre.
Faint white specks flicker; effect UNRESOLVED.
White text typed in centre: 'A', 'ANTIM', 'ANTIMATT', 'ANTIMATTER?'.
No visible change; UNRESOLVED.

Ribbed telescope-like object enters upper-right and drifts left across sky over about 6s, then disappears; white arrows radiating from 'ANTIMATTER?' and brighter stars present by f3709. Onset of arrows UNRESOLVED.
Flames and smoke appear on trees, ground and telescope with red haze; arrows and text remain.
White text and arrows and fire fade out; black 'NOT' appears over 'ANTIMATTER' with black arrows; fire gone by f3843.
Label 'NOT ON FIRE' appears above figure; figure bends to look into telescope.

Scene shrinks into a framed picture on a paper sheet with tilt; text 'ANTIMATTER, OTHER THAN EARTH, IT IS NOT.' appears; title 'NOT EVERYTHING IS ANTIMATTER' with 'GALLAGHER, ET AL' and 'ABSTRACT:' text.
Hard cut to red end card with T-rex on satellite left, credits right, 'GET THE BOOKS: xkcd.com/books', four book covers.
